text:
kai: quick idea: prefer trailers for large streaming resume tokens to avoid inflating request headers and leaking checkpoints.

maria: trailers good but many clients/proxies lack support. we need a clear fallback.

ingrid: hybrid approach: client sends a tiny `X-RW-Session: v1|sid` header; server emits `Resume-Trailer: v1|base64(...)` as final trailer. proxies that don't support trailers persist the trailer to an edge-store keyed by sid.

sam.w: security note: trailer blobs must be HMAC-signed and must not include raw user ids. ops needs a key rotation plan and KMS degrade policy (e.g., kms->hmac).

kai: resume handshake sketch: proxy issues `Resume-Start: v1|sid|offset|hmac` to backend on resume; backend must reply with `Resume-Ack: v1|ok|offset` or `Resume-Nack: v1|reason`. avoid opaque 5xx on resume path.

maria: add route-level config: `stream.resume = { mode: off | trailers | header_fallback, retention_seconds: int }`. default `off` for side-effecting flows.

ops-bot: created RW-5010: "streaming resume handshake compatibility matrix" and pinged #eng-oncall.
